conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: AGI, or Strong AI, refers to hypothetical AI that can understand, learn, and apply intelligence across a wide range of tasks, much like a human. It would possess cognitive abilities that allow it to solve any intellectual task that a human being can.
